title: EvidenceManifest
description: The evidence manifest a v2 or v3 statement binds by digest, published beside the statement as `witnessEvidenceManifest`. Canonical bytes: entries sorted by check_id, each as {"check_id":..,"source":..} or {"check_id":..,"commitment":..}, no whitespace, UTF-8.

ManifestEntry.title: ManifestEntry
ManifestEntry.description: One check and the evidence behind it: a public `source`, or a `commitment` to a private one. Exactly one of the two.

check_id.description: The check id. Unique in the manifest.

source.description: The public URL the check read.

commitment.description: `sha256:` plus the hex SHA-256 of salt, a newline byte and the private reference. Only its holder can open it.
